rates.label: All classes
rates.value: About 2% of insured value per year

assumptions: The demo date is 2026-11-16 and the forward horizon is 12 months.
Road distance is straight-line distance x 1.3; a truck move costs $150 plus $4.50/km.
The internal rental rate is 88% of the outside rate. Research suggests about 75%, so this is an assumption.
A purchase only counts if it breaks even within 6 months. Break-even compares depreciation plus carrying cost with outside rental avoided, not the cash purchase price.
The backtest history and its availability flags are synthetic. Buy is excluded from the replay.
Equipment, projects, companies and sites are fictional Northgate Group data.
